role: The fixed-function GL state the world entity passes draw with: a Mesa-exact modelview (rs_gl_*), RenderHelper's two item lights in eye space under the camera modelview, the normal through the inverse transpose with GL_RESCALE_NORMAL, glColor, the lightmap coordinates and a texture matrix, feeding the entity quad rasterizer; ModelBox display lists and renderItemIn2D on top.

structs.name: glx
structs.java: the GL state a Render class draws under: modelview, lights, glColor, glNormal3f, the lightmap coordinates, GL_TEXTURE

gpu: per-quad struct copies of the raster target (glx_quad); no allocation, no statics but the white texel
notes: lane/entrender. Mirrors raster_hand.c's hand_ctx for the world passes (fog on, the camera modelview).
